limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Verified procurement/defense-industrial events: Pentagon munitions-plan watchdog, Denmark-US defense deal, UK defense job cuts, Israel-Czech and India-Japan defense manufacturing talks, Leidos air-defense work, and Pentagon audit; sports and legal 'defense' false positives excluded.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Australia's surprise unemployment spike (well corroborated) shifts RBA expectations; euro-area construction, UK manufacturing orders, India/Malaysia growth data provide cross-market growth signals; local US county unemployment excluded except as corroboration.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Authoritative supply data (EIA chokepoints, gas inventories), major-power oil supply agreement, Oman gas deal, and supply-surge/war-premium dynamics drive global energy ETFs; local pump-price and stock-pick items deprioritized.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: ECB Financial Stability Review flags systemic risks (AI valuations, fiscal, geoeconomic) as the top authoritative signal; supplemented by default-deadline loan talks, private credit default nerves, CMBS special servicing, and rising consumer credit stress.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Drug-approval milestones (obinutuzumab, Regeneron, Infilbray, J&J filing) and concrete policy state changes (NC Medicaid expansion, CMS MA audit recoveries, Maine Medicaid delay, Medicare payment stoppage) affect healthcare ETFs; opinion and how-to pieces excluded.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified state changes with global transmission: US-Venezuela military deal, Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure, Israel-Iran escalation risk, Denmark ratifying Greenland defense deal, Red Sea shipping security, and US sanctions actions; selected over local crime, campus, and promotional items.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Central-bank policy signals (FOMC minutes, euro-area inflation, South Africa hold, Fed target comments) and key national inflation prints (Japan, Canada, Cyprus) directly affect rate-sensitive ETF positioning.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: US government-shutdown deal is the clearest macro-relevant political event; major natural-hazard state changes (Indonesia M6.6 quake, Cook Islands emergency, Florida/France floods, Texas wildfires, Japan quake) have transmission via insurance/commodities; local debris notices excluded.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Gold below $3,700 on Fed hike signals is the dominant price-moving event with corroboration; large decline, Bangladesh price cuts, Nigeria-UAE gold trade gap, and supply-side feasibility/resource updates are material; stock options, board appointments, and sports 'gold' excluded.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Chip-export controls and Nvidia/China shipment data are the highest-transmission AI signals; grid/power constraints from data centers, China countermeasure threats, state subpoena, and nuclear/space data-center deals are material; local zoning bans and stock-picking deprioritized.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Verified policy state changes affecting cross-border trade: US-China truce timeline, Canada's China EV tariff, India-US and Canada-US negotiations, China lifting pork tariffs, and Thailand/Cambodia deals; excludes retail refunds and local utility tariffs.
